stem.text: Which compounds produce three **different** organic products when hydrolysed?

items.alt: Skeletal formula of CH3CO2CH2CH2CO2CH3: a methyl ethanoate-type ester with an ethanoate group at one end and a methyl ester at the other.
Skeletal formula of CH3OC(=O)CH(CH3)CH2C(=O)OCH3: two methyl ester groups joined by a chain with a methyl branch.
Skeletal formula of a six-membered lactone ring with a C=O and a ring oxygen, bearing a CH2OC(=O)CH3 substituent (an ethanoate ester).
